items.title: Merge with Caution:�A Developer’s Guide to the Risks Hiding in AI-Generated Code
items.summary: Presented at DevFest Kansas City 2026.Merge with Caution: A Developer's Guide to the Risks Hiding in AI Generated CodeAI coding assistants now write a large share of the code developers merge. That code often looks correct but can carry hidden risks. This talk explains what has changed since AI joined the workflow and where things go wrong.It uses a simple four-boundary model, published with OWASP: Developer to Agent, Agent to Repo, Repo to CI/CD, and CI/CD to Production. It covers insecure AI-generated code, hallucinated package names (slopsquatting), prompt injection through content the agent reads, and leaked secrets.It ends with practical habits developers can start using to review and gate AI-generated code before it ships.Covers: AI coding assistants, trust boundaries, threat modeling, prompt injection, slopsquatting, secrets, CI/CD security, software supply chain.
